article.title: From Motivation to Discipline
article.content: Motivation feels powerful, but it is often unstable. Some days you feel energetic, and some days you do not want to start. Discipline helps bridge this gap. It means doing the planned task even when enthusiasm is low. Building discipline is easier with clear routines, small goals, and visible progress tracking. Once a behavior becomes automatic, it requires less mental effort. In the long run, discipline creates consistency, and consistency creates results.
